problem: Netlify production auto-deploy stopped emitting production deploys for current main, while the previous GitHub fallback credential had expired and could not be safely refreshed through the repository secret interface available to the agent.
root_cause: Production delivery depended on a long-lived GitHub Actions secret containing a Netlify MCP proxy credential. That credential can expire independently of the repository and the connected Netlify account, creating a manual secret-rotation hard boundary.
prevention: Production Source Snapshot obtains deploy transport at runtime through GitHub OIDC, not a long-lived repository secret.
The OIDC bridge must validate issuer, audience, repository, ref and exact workflow_ref before returning a deploy credential.
The Netlify credential stays encrypted in Supabase Vault and is retrieved only with service-role authority after successful OIDC validation.
Never print, commit, upload as artifact, or expose the deploy proxy in chat or workflow logs; mask it before exporting to the job environment.
Terminal closure still requires exact Netlify production SHA plus pricing/i18n browser proof.
